text-1: You can watch each solution in video format on bcore's official YouTube channel, bcoreTV.
text-2: In this video, we introduce our collaboration with Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. to eliminate human errors in automotive factories using colorbit and iPhone for verifying proper hose and fitting connections.
text-left: Colorbit® can read multiple codes simultaneously with a single camera. This demo shows how multiple people and objects can be identified at once.
text-right: This solution streamlines access control and personnel identification in food factories using “Colorbit®”. Cameras recognize colorbit tags attached to uniforms, automatically recording who entered a high-hygiene area, when, and where.
